hook.text: Add 'un-' to 'do' and you reverse the action. Add 'redo' and you repeat it.

buildup.text: Prefixes attach before the root and typically change meaning rather than grammar.

discovery.text: English prefixes often come from Latin or Greek: anti-, pre-, sub-, inter-.

twist.text: In Bantu languages prefixes mark noun class, plural, and tense—all before the root.

climax.text: Prefixes rarely change a word's part of speech—'happy' stays an adjective as 'unhappy.'

punchline.text: Prefix the root and the meaning shifts.
